author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Want automatic subtitles in the free version of DaVinci Resolve? In this video I show you step-by-step how to use the Magic Subtitles Lite plugin from MrAlexTech to generate AI subtitles, create animated word-by-word captions, and drop them directly onto your timeline inside the free version of DaVinci Resolve. We’ll go through download, install, setup with Vibe, and a full workflow from download to subtitle generation, all without needing Resolve Studio. Perfect for YouTube videos, Shorts, TikToks, and Reels.

Host: Tim Seneker

📚 RESOURCES
- Magic Subtitles Lite: https://www.mralextech.com/a/hrt6x

⌚ TIMESTAMPS
0:00 - Download MagicSubtitlesLite
0:39 - Install MagicSubtitlesLite and Add to Timeline
1:13 - Install Vibe
1:44 - Basic Subtitle Settings
2:17 - Actually Create the Subtitles
2:35 - Export Subtitles
2:47 - Add Subtitles to Timeline for Customization/Animation
